recognize_zh: 周邊血中四顆大型母細胞聚在一起，細緻染色質、藍色細胞質，其中幾顆細胞質內有細小深色顆粒（可能為嗜鹼性顆粒），右側一顆有清楚淡藍細胞質邊緣，符合 CML 急性轉化中的母細胞。
features: Cluster of four large blasts with high N:C ratio and fine chromatin
Several blasts with fine dark cytoplasmic granules, suggestive of basophilic differentiation
One blast with a smooth rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm and small nuclear vacuole
Irregular, folded nuclear contour in the left-hand blast
Smudged cell debris at upper right and red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of four large blasts with fine chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm; several contain fine dark cytoplasmic granules suggestive of basophilic differentiation, while one is agranular. Smudged cell debris and red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis are present. Findings are consistent with blast phase of CML, BCR-ABL1-positive, possibly with basophilic features; flow cytometry and cytochemistry can clarify lineage.

ddx.vs: Blasts with basophilic granules without a CML history or BCR-ABL1 favor this rare de novo entity.
Mast cells have round/oval nuclei with evenly distributed metachromatic granules, express CD117 and tryptase, and carry KIT D816V rather than BCR-ABL1.
APL cells have bilobed nuclei, dense azurophilic granules and Auer rods with PML::RARA, rather than fine dark basophilic granules.
